nodes.summary:
Experimental local JSON protocol companion; reads one request on stdin and writes its response on stdout.
--browser-cache: populated pinned Playwright browser cache seed
--bundle-dir: retained companion bundle directory
--expected-commit: frozen Corvint source commit
--expected-tree: frozen Corvint source tree
--go-authority-bundle: core: canonical trusted-local Go authority attachment
--go-authority-sha256: core: frozen Go authority attachment SHA-256
--node: canonical Node executable
--node-sha256: core: frozen Node executable SHA-256
--npm-cache: populated npm cache seed
--npm-sha256: core: frozen npm CLI SHA-256
--output: new retained result JSON path
--python: canonical Python executable
--python-sha256: frozen Python executable SHA-256
--qualification: qualification profile: editor or core
--scratch: fresh owned scratch path
--source-root: clean source root used to build this checker
usage: corvint-public-release-check [--browser-cache VALUE] [--bundle-dir VALUE] [--expected-commit VALUE] [--expected-tree VALUE] [--go-authority-bundle VALUE] [--go-authority-sha256 VALUE] [--node VALUE] [--node-sha256 VALUE] [--npm-cache VALUE] [--npm-sha256 VALUE] [--output VALUE] [--python VALUE] [--python-sha256 VALUE] [--qualification VALUE] [--scratch VALUE] [--source-root VALUE]
